import hashlib
import inspect
import json
import re
import socket

SERVER = NEXT / "server"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "docs/reports/evidence/pdos-next-wave11-20261002/source-contract-check.json"

files = {}
def hashed(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "size_bytes": len(data)}
tracked = [
    ROOT / "docs/design/2026-10-02-pdos-complete-target-architecture-v1.md",
    NEXT / "tools/export_contracts.py",
    NEXT / "tools/validate_contracts.py",

    SERVER / "pdos_next/service.py",
    SERVER / "pdos_next/command_handlers.py",
    SERVER / "pdos_next/operational_import.py",
    SERVER / "pdos_next/professional_import.py",
    SERVER / "pdos_next/operational_bootstrap.py",
    *sorted((NEXT / "contracts").glob("*.json")),
]
for path in tracked:
    files[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = hashed(path)
attempts = []
def deny_io(*args, **kwargs):
    attempts.append("forbidden database/network construction or connection")
    raise AssertionError("Read-only schema inspection cannot create/connect engines or sockets")
import sqlalchemy
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
sqlalchemy.create_engine = deny_io

Engine.raw_connection = deny_io

from pdos_next.service import EVENTS

# Hash imported source before evaluating model schemas or constructing app routes.
for module in list(sys.modules.values()):
    filename = getattr(module, "__file__", None)
    if filename:
        path = Path(filename).resolve()
        if path.is_file() and path.is_relative_to(SERVER / "pdos_next") and path.suffix == ".py":
            files[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = hashed(path)
catalogs = {name: json.loads((NEXT / "contracts" / f"{name}.json").read_text())
            for name in ("operations", "events", "acceptance", "auxiliary-operations")}
source_path = ROOT / "docs/design/2026-10-02-pdos-complete-target-architecture-v1.md"
source = source_path.read_text()
source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
canonical = {v["operation"]: v for v in catalogs["operations"]["items"]}
auxiliary = {v["operation"]: v for v in catalogs["auxiliary-operations"]["items"]}
tick = chr(96)
source_operations = re.findall(r"\| " + tick + r"([^" + tick + r"]+)" + tick + r" \| (READ|T[012]) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \|", source)
source_acceptance = re.findall(r"\| (AT-\d{2}) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \|", source)
checks = {}
def check(name, condition, details=None):
    checks[name] = {"passed": bool(condition)}
    if details is not None:
        checks[name]["details"] = details
check("canonical_counts_and_unique_keys",
      len(canonical) == len(catalogs["operations"]["items"]) == 66
      and len({v["type"] for v in catalogs["events"]["items"]}) == len(catalogs["events"]["items"]) == 65
      and len({v["id"] for v in catalogs["acceptance"]["items"]}) == len(catalogs["acceptance"]["items"]) == 48)
check("canonical_catalogs_source_provenance",
      all(catalogs[name]["provenance"]["sha256"] == source_hash
          and catalogs[name]["provenance"]["original_contract_package_received"] is False
          for name in ("operations", "events", "acceptance")))
check("canonical_operation_policy_matches_design",
      len(source_operations) == 66 and {v[0] for v in source_operations} == set(canonical)
      and all(canonical[op]["write_tier"] == tier
              and canonical[op]["ai_execution"] == ai.strip()
              and canonical[op]["event"] == (None if tier == "READ" else event.strip())
              for op, tier, ai, event in source_operations))
check("canonical_event_operation_pairs",
      {(v["type"], v["operation"]) for v in catalogs["events"]["items"]}
      == {(v["event"], op) for op, v in canonical.items() if v["event"]})
check("canonical_stage_mapping_closed",
      all(v["stage"] in {f"G{n}" for n in range(6)}
          for name in ("operations", "events", "acceptance") for v in catalogs[name]["items"])
      and all(v["stage"] == canonical[v["operation"]]["stage"] for v in catalogs["events"]["items"]))
check("acceptance_ids_and_text_match_design",
      len(source_acceptance) == 48
      and {v["id"] for v in catalogs["acceptance"]["items"]} == {f"AT-{n:02}" for n in range(1, 49)}
      and {(v["id"], v["scenario"], v["expected"]) for v in catalogs["acceptance"]["items"]}
      == {(identifier, scenario.strip(), expected.strip()) for identifier, scenario, expected in source_acceptance})
check("acceptance_definition_only",
      all(v.get("definition_only") is True and "evidence_status" not in v
          for v in catalogs["acceptance"]["items"]))
implemented = set(PAYLOADS)
canonical_implemented = implemented & set(canonical)
auxiliary_implemented = implemented & set(auxiliary)
host_extensions = implemented - set(canonical) - set(auxiliary)
check("registered_payload_count", len(PAYLOADS) == 37)
check("canonical_implementation_markers_match_registry",
      {op for op, v in canonical.items() if v.get("implementation") == "implemented_local_slice"}
      == canonical_implemented
      and all(canonical[op].get("payload_schema") == "payloads.schema.json" for op in canonical_implemented))
check("auxiliary_registered_closed_and_t1",
      len(auxiliary) == len(catalogs["auxiliary-operations"]["items"]) == 10
      and set(auxiliary) <= implemented and not (set(auxiliary) & set(canonical))
      and all(v["write_tier"] == "T1" and op in T1_OPERATIONS
              and v["implementation"] == "implemented_local_slice"
              and v["payload_schema"] == "payloads.schema.json"
              for op, v in auxiliary.items()))
check("auxiliary_runtime_events_match",
      all(EVENTS.get(op) == v["event"] for op, v in auxiliary.items()))
check("auxiliary_canonical_policy_preserved",
      all(rule.rsplit(":", 1)[0] in canonical
          and canonical[rule.rsplit(":", 1)[0]]["write_tier"] == rule.rsplit(":", 1)[1]
          for v in auxiliary.values() for rule in v.get("canonical_policy_preserved", [])))
check("implemented_canonical_runtime_events_match",
      all(EVENTS.get(op) == canonical[op]["event"] for op in canonical_implemented))
generated_payloads = {
    "command_envelope": Command.model_json_schema(),
    "operation_payloads": {op: payload.model_json_schema() for op, payload in PAYLOADS.items()},
    "scope": "implemented local domain slices; real AI qualification and formal exits are separate",
}
saved_payloads = json.loads((NEXT / "contracts/payloads.schema.json").read_text())
check("payload_export_exact_structural_equality", generated_payloads == saved_payloads)
check("payload_export_operation_set_exact", set(saved_payloads["operation_payloads"]) == implemented)
check("registered_payload_extra_forbid", all(payload.model_config.get("extra") == "forbid" for payload in PAYLOADS.values()))
# The exporter uses these two inert objects too. No lifespan/request/startup runs.
app = create_app(engine=object(), auth_engine=object())
generated_openapi = app.openapi()
saved_openapi = json.loads((NEXT / "contracts/openapi.json").read_text())
check("openapi_export_exact_structural_equality", generated_openapi == saved_openapi)
check("professional_read_route_exported",
      "get" in generated_openapi["paths"].get("/v1/products/{product_id}/verification-professional", {}))
trusted_imports = {"build.operational_facts.import", "professional.authority.import"}
check("trusted_host_imports_not_public_payloads_or_catalogs",
      not (trusted_imports & (implemented | set(canonical) | set(auxiliary))))
check("trusted_host_imports_no_public_handler",
      all(handler(op) is None for op in trusted_imports))
check("trusted_host_imports_no_public_endpoint",
      not any("import_operational_fact" in getattr(route.endpoint, "__code__", type("Empty", (), {"co_names": ()})).co_names
              or "import_professional_fact" in getattr(route.endpoint, "__code__", type("Empty", (), {"co_names": ()})).co_names
              or "trusted_import" in getattr(route.endpoint, "__code__", type("Empty", (), {"co_names": ()})).co_names
              for route in app.routes)
      and not any("import" in path for path in generated_openapi["paths"]))
from pdos_next.service import execute
execute_source = inspect.getsource(execute)
check("public_dispatch_closed_before_database_scope_access",
      execute_source.index("payload_cls = PAYLOADS.get(command.operation)")
      < execute_source.index("if not payload_cls:") < execute_source.index("raise DomainError")
      < execute_source.index("product = s.scalar("))
check("trusted_host_import_events_are_trace_only",
      EVENTS.get("build.operational_facts.import") == "build.operational_facts_imported"
      and EVENTS.get("professional.authority.import") == "professional.authority_imported")
check("wave11_build_tiers_closed_and_exported",
      {"build.engineering.authorize", "build.manufacturing.authorize"} == set(T2_OPERATIONS)
      and not (set(T2_OPERATIONS) & set(T1_OPERATIONS))
      and "build.start" in T1_OPERATIONS
      and "build.readiness.compute" not in T1_OPERATIONS | T2_OPERATIONS
      and {"build.start", "build.engineering.authorize", "build.manufacturing.authorize"} <= implemented)
check("build_start_routes_exported",
      "get" in generated_openapi["paths"].get("/v1/products/{product_id}/build-start", {})
      and "post" in generated_openapi["paths"].get("/v1/products/{product_id}/build-start/assessment-inputs", {}))
check("no_database_or_network_attempts", not attempts, {"attempts": attempts})
stable = []
for path, before in files.items():
    after = hashed(ROOT / path)
    if after != before:
        stable.append({"before": before, "after": after})
check("all_reviewed_files_stable_during_inspection", not stable, {"changed_files": stable})
payload_sources = []
for op, model in sorted(PAYLOADS.items()):
    path = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(model)).resolve()
    payload_sources.append({
        "operation": op, "model": f"{model.__module__}.{model.__name__}",
        "source": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "source_sha256": files[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]["sha256"],
        "classification": "canonical" if op in canonical else "auxiliary" if op in auxiliary else "host_extension",
        "event": EVENTS.get(op),
    })
failed = [name for name, result in checks.items() if not result["passed"]]
report = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "reviewer": "reuse_foundation",
    "reviewed_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "result": {
        "status": "pass" if not failed else "fail",
        "failed_checks": failed,
        "canonical_operations": len(canonical),
        "canonical_events": len(catalogs["events"]["items"]),
        "acceptance_scenarios": len(catalogs["acceptance"]["items"]),
        "registered_payloads": len(PAYLOADS),
        "registered_canonical_payloads": len(canonical_implemented),
        "auxiliary_operations": len(auxiliary),
        "registered_host_extensions": len(host_extensions),
        "reviewed_files": len(files),
        "openapi_paths": len(generated_openapi["paths"]),
        "openapi_component_schemas": len(generated_openapi["components"]["schemas"]),
    },
    "method": {
        "command": "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 pdos-next/server/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY' ... PY",
        "execution": "One in-memory reconstruction of the exporter schemas and create_app(engine=object(), auth_engine=object()).openapi(), plus read-only source/catalog comparisons. exporter was read, not executed; no export or source files written.",
        "runtime_guards": "sqlalchemy.create_engine, Engine.connect/raw_connection and socket connect entry points replaced with a raising function before application imports.",
        "database_access": False, "network_access": False, "lifespan_started": False,

        "runtime_secrets_read": False,
        "only_written_file": str(OUTPUT.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "exporter_source": "pdos-next/tools/export_contracts.py",
        "validator_source": "pdos-next/tools/validate_contracts.py",
        "program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(__inspection_program__.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "program": __inspection_program__,
    },
    "checks": checks,

    "canonical_registered_operations": sorted(canonical_implemented),

    "auxiliary_registered_operations": sorted(auxiliary_implemented),

import hashlib, json, socket, sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
OUTPUT = ROOT / "docs/reports/evidence/pdos-next-wave11-20261002/source-contract-check.json"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "pdos-next/server"))
attempts = []
def deny_io(*args, **kwargs):
    attempts.append("database_or_network_connection")
    raise RuntimeError("Read-only source-contract review prohibits connections")
import sqlalchemy
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
sqlalchemy.create_engine = deny_io
Engine.connect = deny_io
Engine.raw_connection = deny_io
socket.create_connection = deny_io
socket.socket.connect = deny_io
socket.socket.connect_ex = deny_io
from pdos_next.contracts import PAYLOADS
from pdos_next.command_handlers import T1_OPERATIONS, T2_OPERATIONS
report = json.loads(OUTPUT.read_text())
aux = json.loads((ROOT / "pdos-next/contracts/auxiliary-operations.json").read_text())["items"]
canonical = json.loads((ROOT / "pdos-next/contracts/operations.json").read_text())["items"]
aux_ops = {item["operation"] for item in aux}
canonical_ops = {item["operation"] for item in canonical}
tiers = {tier: sorted(item["operation"] for item in aux if item["write_tier"] == tier) for tier in ["T1", "T2"]}
tier_match = (
    len(aux) == len(aux_ops) == 12
    and not aux_ops & canonical_ops
    and aux_ops <= set(PAYLOADS)
    and len(tiers["T1"]) == 10 and len(tiers["T2"]) == 2
    and set(tiers["T1"]) <= T1_OPERATIONS
    and set(tiers["T2"]) == set(T2_OPERATIONS)
    and not T1_OPERATIONS & T2_OPERATIONS
    and all(item["implementation"] == "implemented_local_slice" and item["payload_schema"] == "payloads.schema.json" for item in aux)
    and {item["operation"]: item["executor"] for item in aux if item["write_tier"] == "T2"} == {
        "build.engineering.authorize": "named_qualified_engineering",
        "build.manufacturing.authorize": "named_qualified_manufacturing",
    }
)
report["checks"].pop("auxiliary_registered_closed_and_t1")
report["checks"]["auxiliary_registered_closed_and_tier_matched"] = {
    "passed": tier_match, "details": {"counts": {"T1": 10, "T2": 2}, "operations": tiers}
}
changed = []
for entry in report["file_hashes"]:
    path = ROOT / entry["path"]
    if not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != entry["sha256"]:
        changed.append(entry["path"])
report["checks"]["reviewed_file_hashes_unchanged_at_finalization"] = {"passed": not changed, "details": {"reviewed_files": len(report["file_hashes"]), "changed_files": changed}}
report["checks"]["no_database_or_network_attempts_in_correction"] = {"passed": not attempts, "details": {"attempts": attempts}}
report["result"]["auxiliary_tiers"] = {"T1": len(tiers["T1"]), "T2": len(tiers["T2"])}
report["result"]["failed_checks"] = [name for name, outcome in report["checks"].items() if not outcome["passed"]]
report["result"]["status"] = "pass" if not report["result"]["failed_checks"] else "fail"
report["findings"][0]["detail"] = (
    "These two preexisting public server extensions are present in PAYLOADS, exported payload schemas and runtime EVENTS outside the 66-operation canonical and 12-operation auxiliary catalogs. "
    "The Wave11 engineering/manufacturing T2 authorizations are explicitly cataloged auxiliary operations. "
    "The trusted professional/operational host imports are not public commands."
)
report["method"]["execution"] = (
    "One in-memory reconstruction of exporter schemas and inert create_app OpenAPI, followed by this limited auxiliary-registry tier correction and final hash comparison. "
    "No schema/OpenAPI reconstruction was repeated. Exporter/validator were read, not executed. Only this report was written."
)
report["method"]["initial_observation"] = {
    "legacy_method_assumption": "Wave10 auxiliary count=10 and all T1",
    "observed_wave11_contract": "12 auxiliary operations: ten T1 and two named professional T2",
    "classification": "review-method adaptation; no implementation/export mismatch",
    "original_memory_reconstruction_passed": ["payload_export_exact_structural_equality", "openapi_export_exact_structural_equality"],
}
program = sys.argv[1]
report["method"]["correction_program"] = program
report["method"]["correction_program_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(program.encode()).hexdigest()
report["method"]["correction_command"] = "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 pdos-next/server/.venv/bin/python - <correction-program> <<'PY' [correction_program] PY"
report["reviewed_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"result": report["result"], "report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(OUTPUT.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}, ensure_ascii=False))
